Volvo CE and InfraServe Global launch new equipment at Indian expo

Volvo CE launched its EC650 mining excavator and showcased other construction and mining equipment at the bauma CONEXPO INDIA 2026 event. Simultaneously, InfraServe Global launched five new products at the same expo. The event focused on construction and mining equipment solutions.
